time_scale: Eight times median strictly positive train inter-event gap; same divisor for every split, both models and future simulation
history_selection: First training record with strictly increasing first four event times; never choose from evaluation
alternative: Future time compression by0.8; generate through1/0.8 before transforming and observing[0,1)
training_objective: Native recorded-transition likelihood, conditioning on first real event; no invented terminal exposure
heldout: Native prediction metrics on published test split; descriptive, not a calibrated real-data fixed-window goodness-of-fit test
generator: Public Simulator; complete finite exposure certified by a sampled crossing event or native certified infinite waiting time; safety failures stop and are retained
correction: Exact paired McNemar, Holm84; unsupported comparisons remain unavailable, not zero p-values
technical_blockage: Each method is an independent sub-study. Cost-blocked methods retain explicit failure status and no p-value; supported methods continue on shared fresh pools. Any failure during a Monte Carlo sub-study stops that cell, never excludes a trial.
scope: Conditional on each of four fixed trained checkpoints and its train-selected common history; no general retraining uncertainty or adequacy claim for the real data
